name: De Sluyswacht
surveyedSource: BAG ring of pand 0363100012182908 (BAG CC0, bouwjaar 1695) with the 3DBAG LoD2.2 ridge (10.1 m) and NW eave (6.9 m) (3DBAG CC BY 4.0) in native east/south metres (scripts/landmarks/sluyswacht-footprints.json, bag-shell-prepare.ts); the massing is authored symmetric because both gables show it. The NW side read from the rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panorama b_20250108_1349_Track08_Sphere_00001 (2025) with TMX7316010203-001981_pano_0000_000794 (2021), the NE gable from TMX7316010203-000354_pano_0001_001178 (2017, square on) and TMX7316010203-001981_pano_0000_000796 (2021), the SW street gable from TMX7316010203-001664_pano_0000_001558 (2020) and TMX7316010203-000492_pano_0000_000027 (2017), CC BY 4.0; the SE side has no panorama and is inferred. Per wall in scripts/landmarks/sluyswacht-inventory.json.

attribution.title: De Sluyswacht, Jodenbreestraat 1, Amsterdam: the lock-keeper's house on the Sint Antoniessluis (1695, rijksmonument)
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the BAG ring (CC0) of pand 0363100012182908 with the 3DBAG LoD2.2 ridge and eave heights (CC BY 4.0): the two pointed gables with white verge boards and kneelers, the black-painted walls, the white-framed cross windows, shutters and hoist hatch, the pantile roof with its dormer, the ground-storey doors and the "de Sluyswacht" lettering, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
